challenges: Desk-edge cable clip
A clip that holds three cables along the edge of a desk 18–25 mm thick.
Show it on a desk, rendered or real, with the fit you chose.
A planetary gear stage
A planetary stage with a 1:4 or 1:5 ratio that a hand crank can turn.
Post the ratio, the tooth counts and the critique's numbers.
A textured grip
A handle or grip with a texture you would want to hold: knurl, ribs or a fine mesh texture.
Say which tier the texture is (CAD geometry or mesh texture) and why.
A product shell
The housing of a small product: a remote, a speaker, a mouse. Lofted, not boxy.
Show the six-view sheet and the section.
Mesh to CAD
Take an STL you own and rebuild it as editable CAD with Make editable.
Post the layer reached, the Hausdorff distance and one edit you made.
A print-in-place hinge
A case or a box with a hinge that works straight out of the build.
Show it opening, rendered or real. Say the clearance you used.
A replacement knob
A knob for something you own whose knob broke or went missing.
Measure the shaft and say how you measured it.
A camera mount
An Arca-type plate or a clamp for a camera or a phone.
Name the interface dimensions and where they come from.
A lamp
A table lamp or a shade: a revolve, a loft or a lattice.
A photoreal render counts as much as a photo.
A four-bar mechanism
Anything that moves on a four-bar linkage: a gripper, a lid, a toy.
Post the Grashof class and the transmission angle from form.craft.
A helmet or visor
A shell for a head, a model or a toy: lofted from sections.
Show the critique's symmetry and fillet numbers.
A drawer organiser from one number
Dividers for a drawer, made from its inside width alone.
Say the one number you measured.
A snap-fit enclosure
An enclosure for a small board that closes with snap fits, no screws.
Post the snap's strain from form.craft.
Something you fixed
Free brief: a part that fixed something broken in your home.
Tell the story: what broke, what you measured, how it fits now.
